args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding, but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` (despite its docstring saying ROUND_HALF_EVEN).

This changes `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring, the test, and FIN-212.

Note: this changes behavior for exact half-cent amounts (e.g. 2.665 now rounds to 2.66 instead of 2.67).

CI: ci-0001 passed on 08d3cd5986.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug on a new branch, CI passed, and I opened PR #101 against main with alex as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

- **Cause:** `round_money` in `src/money.py` rounded with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, even though its own docstring says banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as FIN-212 and `tests/test_money.py` expect.
- **Fix:** On branch `fix/money-round-half-even` (commit 08d3cd5986), I switched it to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. That was the only change.
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed.
- **Behaviour change:** Amounts that land exactly on a half cent now round to the even cent. For example, 2.665 becomes 2.66 instead of 2.67. I noted this in the PR description.

I couldn't open FIN-212 itself because the advisory lookup didn't recognise that ID. I used the requirement as stated in the test and docstring instead.

I haven't merged the PR, since merging into main needs a code owner's approval.
